findings.title: No ADR records the supply-chain/attestation hardening decision
evidence: SEC-P1-001/SUPPLY-* fixes landed via PRs without an ADR
findings.impact: Architecturally significant trust decisions are only in code/PRs, not in the design record, weakening future review.
findings.recommendation: Add an ADR for the detached-attestation and SBOM/supply-chain policy so the rationale is durable.

report: Extensibility: versioned compatibility axes (score, ghost, tricks, rating, economy, progression, event/course, replay, social) with explicit bump rules; 37 ADRs index extensibility decisions. Residual: the recent supply-chain/attestation hardening has no ADR recording the decision.
